press_references.value: Halter Launches World-First Virtual Fencing via Satellite, Unlocking Ranch Management Anywhere

product_launches.description: Halter launched its direct-to-satellite smart cattle collars and a major software upgrade that bring virtual fencing and advanced animal and pasture management tools to remote ranches without cellular coverage.

press_references.value: New national monument site opening near Santa Cruz will feature first-of-its-kind technology

product_launches.description: Halter, a New Zealand-based company, has deployed its advanced GPS-enabled virtual fencing system for cattle at the Cotoni-Coast Dairies national monument site near Santa Cruz, marking one of the first uses of this technology in a park-like setting in the U.S.

overview_description.description: Halter provides GPS-enabled collars and software that help farmers monitor and control cattle movement. Its system uses virtual fencing to guide animals without physical barriers, allowing users to manage grazing patterns and land use through a mobile interface. The platform collects data on animal location, behavior, and health indicators, supporting day-to-day farm operations and decision-making. Halter also enables remote shifting of herds, reducing the need for manual labor in moving livestock. Its services are used in agricultural settings to improve pasture utilization and streamline herd management processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Halter is an agtech company that develops a smart collar for cattle that enables virtual fencing and real-time monitoring.

product.name: Halter System
product.description: A cattle-management system combining solar-powered GPS collars with a mobile app and farm connectivity to create virtual fences, move herds remotely, and monitor animal location, behavior, pasture use, heat, and health.

product.name: Halter for Dairy
product.description: A dairy-farm management solution for virtual fencing, remote cow shifting, pasture allocation, automatic heat detection, and behavior-based health alerts through Halter collars, connectivity infrastructure, and the mobile app.

product.name: Halter for Beef
product.description: A beef-cattle and ranch-management solution that uses GPS collars and a mobile app to create virtual fences, rotate pastures, move cattle remotely, and monitor herd location and activity in remote areas.

identifier.value: Halter Customer Support and Farm Deployment

product.name: Halter Customer Support and Farm Deployment
product.description: Implementation and ongoing support for Halter customers, including animal training, installation guidance, regional account management, and 24/7 assistance with the system and app.
